provenance_note: These figures were reported by the user in chat, described as originating from Adam real (nero_core.research_agent.pipeline) GitHub Actions run on 2026-08-03: 9 hypotheses generated, all 9 rejected TOO_SLOW by the frequency gate, claimed 24-32 trades/year vs measured 2.5-15 trades/year, ~4.79x average overestimate. sample_size_caveat: CC-1 directive, item A6: this run predates commit 5dd51a0 ('Add full-history research candle export, split from the website's 200-row display export'), which did not exist on 2026-08-03 -- before that split, every (asset, timeframe) pair's ONLY available candle source was the website's own 200-row display export. At the 4h timeframe (the only timeframe in nero_core.asset_universe.APPROVED_RESEARCH_UNIVERSE), 200 rows covers 200*4h = 800h = ~33.3 days, well under a year. The measured_trades_per_year figures above (2.5-15) were therefore almost certainly annualized from a ~33-trading-day sample, not a full year of candles -- an extrapolation, not a direct year-long measurement, and the true measured frequency over a full year could differ meaningfully (either direction) from what a ~33-day window implies. This does NOT invalidate the qualitative finding (claimed rates were still overestimates, all 9 were still correctly rejected TOO_SLOW), but the precise ~4.79x figure should be treated as provisional until re-measured against the full-history research export the above commit now provides. Flagged here for that re-measurement; not yet re-run.
